Not geographically, but spiritually. The Thrillbilly Mud Club is the closest you'll ever get to the essence of these united states. It's where working men and women commune with dirt bikes, off-road vehicles, fireworks, and warm beer. These are the new visionaries and poets of our age – the revving of their engines is the scream of a forgotten generation demanding America's attention. And I couldn't wait to meet them as I drove my RV through the entrance arch proudly draped in flags.~n~~n~What I discovered may surprise you. Yes, there was a high level of avoidable injuries, but there was also a deeper wound that ran through all these dirt-encrusted philosopher-kings – that wound is called 'hope'. Hope for a better tomorrow? Sure. But also a hope for a better present, where a gnarly 360 on a dirt bike, or catching air in a monster truck, is all the American Dream these wasted warriors need.~n~~n~And what of the Queens of the Quagmire? Not a moment passes without a stars and stripes bikini-top being held aloft like a US flag hoisted by our brave soldiers on some far-flung Pacific Island.~n~~n~By four in the morning, I had supped my fill of this swamp-bound bacchanal, but any hope of rest was short-lived as I watched my RV being torched by an enthusiastic crowd – an act I took as one of acceptance. As the dawn light probed over the final flames, I walked to the highway, wiser, and without my pants that had also been taken. 35480206: By Oliver Fairfax~n~~n~It's been over 60 years since the death of President Joe S. Russo. There are few who don't know the haunting image of the President's body floating in the swimming pool of the Lampedusa Hotel in Vice City.~n~~n~Mystery still shrouds the circumstances of the President's death. He was wildly popular in his time, seen as young, charismatic and attractive. But his life was tragically cut short in his swimming shorts that day in November of 1965. The official line is that he was assassinated by a Communist Cuban strike team masquerading as a rumba band. But there are many who cast doubt on this official account. If the Cuban assassins had undertaken the hit to destabilize the US government and escalate the Cold War why didn't the US retaliate? It's not like the US doesn't bomb the shit out of whoever we like.~n~~n~There are many theories, one concerning the Cubans but on the right wing, not the Communist administration. Some have asserted that, yes President Russo was killed by the rumba band, but that they were in fact far-right Cuban dissidents angry with Russo's live-and-let-live attitude to the Communists in Cuba. But this ignores the fact that Russo had many supporters among the Cuban refugees and regularly referred to the Communist Cubans as "Havana Humpdicks".~n~~n~Then there are the theories related to the fact that Russo's autopsy revealed traces of paprika pepper in his stomach. This is a spice popular in Eastern European dishes, leading to theories that Russo was in fact poisoned by a Hungarian secret agent, working for the Russians. But this ignores the fact that paprika is used in many American dishes, like BBQ and Tex Mex cooking.~n~~n~Another theory involves the owner of the Lampedusa Hotel and his famous clientele. Despite being married, Russo had been connected with a famous starlet – Peggy Aydeen – who was also engaged to Herbie Butler, the owner of the Lampedusa. Could Butler have paid the band or poisoned the paprika? Whatever the full story is, it died that day with President Russo on November 21,1965. R.I.P. J.S.R.
